Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Football GPL 2026/2027: Babil’s late strike sends Medeama top Source : Daniel Koranteng 25 October 2026 5:19pm Audio By Carbonatix
Nana Kofi Babil’s 82nd-minute strike earned Medeama SC a hard-fought victory over Aduana FC in Matchday 8 of the Ghana Premier League.
The cagey encounter appeared destined for a draw before Babil struck with just eight minutes of normal time remaining, sending the defending champions back to the top of the league table following Hearts of Oak’s victory on Friday.
The defeat sees Aduana FC slip to seventh place, while Medeama return to winning ways after last week’s loss to Samartex.
